changedOnPurpose: #10108: a change of a grouped monitor's status keeps its series as the monitor log does - those the evaluation acted on first, at most STORED_CHECK_MAX_SIZE_IN_BYTES, and how many there were (MonitorStoredCheck.boundSeries) - so statusChangeLogHash of both cases was rewritten. Before: 1a066f523b96fac2b91ebaf3 and 419fd5aeeb97621b690b9d59. Nothing else changed.

#10704 changed what the monitor summary of a grouped monitor's alert keeps and what a change of its status keeps, and did not rewrite this file: monitorSummaryHash of every created alert (before: fbf2102e7ea779d0d16842c1) and statusChangeLogHash of both cases have been what it made them since. Rewritten with #10841's change, below.

#10841: an event a grouped monitor's alert or incident adds about one series names it (seriesFingerprint), and a record about one series keeps the events about the whole monitor and its own series, never another series' (EvaluationEventSeries). So the events of both cases name their series, and the checks the records keep were rewritten: createdStateLogHash of every created alert, stateChangeLogHash of every resolved one, statusChangeLogHash of both cases. Nothing a check decides changed: its verdict, the alerts it opened and resolved - titles, descriptions, root causes, severities, states - its status, its criteria results, and its events' types, titles and messages are as before.
